title: Rethinking Post-Hoc Calibration in Semantic Segmentation
abstract: arXiv:2607.01902v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Reliable confidence estimates are essential in semantic segmentation, yet modern models often remain miscalibrated. We investigate two overlooked issues in post-hoc calibration. First, adding a constant to all logits leaves softmax probabilities unchanged, but several standard calibrators depend on this arbitrary offset. In segmentation, this offset can vary across pixels or voxels, introducing spatially varying representation dependence. We characterize translation-invariant (TI) calibrators and construct TI counterparts of shift-sensitive methods. Second, calibrating with cross-entropy can degrade segmentation quality due to mismatched training and calibration objectives and limited calibration data. We investigate decision-preserving calibration under argmax- and order-preservation constraints. translated_title: 重新思考语义分割中的事后校准
translated_abstract: 可靠的置信度估计对语义分割至关重要，然而现代模型往往存在校准不佳的问题。我们研究了事后校准中两个被忽视的问题。首先，对所有logits添加一个常数不会改变softmax概率，但若干标准校准器却依赖于这种任意偏移。在分割任务中，该偏移可能在像素或体素之间存在差异，从而引入随空间变化的表示依赖性。我们刻画了平移不变（TI）校准器的特性，并构建了对偏移敏感方法的平移不变对应版本。其次，使用交叉熵进行校准可能因训练目标与校准目标不匹配以及校准数据有限而降低分割质量。我们在argmax保持和顺序保持约束下研究了决策保持校准。由于这些约束将仿射softmax校准器限制为温度缩放，我们引入了更具表达能力的类条件仿射校准器。
tldr: 该论文揭示了事后校准方法对logits任意偏移敏感导致的空间表示依赖问题，并提出平移不变校准器与决策保持的类条件校准方法，在提升校准质量的同时保持语义分割性能。
en_tdlr: This paper identifies spatially varying representation dependence caused by arbitrary logit offsets in post-hoc calibration and proposes translation-invariant calibrators along with decision-preserving class-conditional calibration methods that improve calibration while preserving semantic segmentation quality.
